login.headline: Make decisions that can explain themselves.
login.deck: SOT keeps the conversation, evidence, and final record together — so every agreement has a history you can return to.
login.title: Enter the workspace
login.hint: Continue to the shared record. Your work will stay attached to its source.

workspace.createHint: Documents and sessions live inside a workspace.
workspace.name: Workspace name

profile.title: Profile
profile.userIdHint: Send this id to a workspace owner so they can add you.

members.title: Members
members.hint: Only an owner can add members.

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.notFound: This proposal is gone or you cannot read it.

document.naked: No evidence is linked to this passage.
document.notFound: This document is gone or you cannot read it.
document.startSessionHint: Draft a change with the agent, then propose it.
document.reading: Reading revision {{number}}. This is not the current text.
document.emptyBody: This document has no text yet. Ask the agent for an update in a session.
document.openCitedSession: Open the session this came from

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.empty: Only evidence you cite reaches the document.
sessions.emptyList: No sessions on this document yet.
sessions.previewEmpty: Every turn here becomes the grounds for an update proposed from it.
sessions.bannerOriginal: Only evidence you cite reaches the document.
sessions.bannerShared: A shared session. Nothing reaches a document until you cite it.
sessions.noTurns: No turns yet. Send a message to start.
sessions.notFound: This session is gone or you cannot read it.
sessions.needParticipate: You have read-only access to this workspace.
sessions.needDocument: This session is not attached to a document.
sessions.agentUpdates: The agent writes document updates. Ask for one in the session.
sessions.fork: Continue in a session of your own
sessions.forkHint: Copies this conversation so far. Nothing you write reaches theirs.
sessions.forkOpen: Open the session it came from
sessions.importHint: A conversation from another tool becomes a session, turn by turn. It is marked as imported: SOT did not run it.
sessions.importedBanner: Imported from {{name}}. SOT did not run this exchange.

inbox.empty: Proposals that need your approval land here.

agent.name: SOT Agent
agent.syncFailed: The exchange finished but did not sync. Retry the sync on its own.
agent.disconnected: The response stream dropped. Your input and the partial reply are still on screen. ({{detail}})
agent.stopped: Stopped. The partial reply is still on screen.
agent.attachFailed: The files were not attached, so nothing was sent. ({{detail}})

send.title: Who holds this session
send.reviewHint: This is the conversation they will read. Take out what should not go.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.hint: Invite by email. They are a member once they accept.
